source.question: e-4437
source.value: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\textbf{u}=\langle 1,2 \rangle$ and $\textbf{v}=\langle 3, -3 \rangle.$

decisions.reason: Observed MA content supersedes the stored value

decisions.question: e-4437

source.question: e-4437
source.value:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14043024/assets/f4b59236b774117dfc764389f3525a01c5f4c8429cece16552622f54cfb3d863.png)

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ 2 & -3\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-3)-3\cdot 2 \\  & =-9\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $\det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A = |{-9}| = 9
$$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14043024/assets/b25d71fb75afcb5e4f9e8ce137ec69fb1dfda54aa544b1636e11503273527844.png)

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}3 & 6 \\ -2 & -4\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot (-4)-6\cdot (-2) \\  & =0\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $\det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A = |\,0\,| = 0
$$
